about: v2: B3/C10 Erich and her giant skeletons at the pre-1.75 Roman villa in Cornwall

entries.why: Erich stood at the post-1.75 spot NE of Cornwall Station (61.1k,14.8k; walkthrough 149 'Per patch 1.75: Erich and the Giant Skeletons have been moved northeast of Cornwall Station'); the 1.65 spot is on the hill just south of the Roman villa, Cornwall 53500,54500 (terrain Z), facing south-west to the woods ('southwest facing the woods from the back of the Villa'). Source: wayback Allakhazam quest 149 'Chains of Death' (2004 capture, pre-1.75): 'a ruined Roman villa ... undead Romans ... your goal is not the villa itself, but a spot a little behind it on the hill to the south. There you will see a few giant skeletons, and a woman nearby named Erich'; the villa is the Roman Temple fixture (zone 6 fixture 117, Cornwall 53760,50560) with the skeletal centurion/legionnaire camp; the Prima Atlas Cornwall map groups CENTURION, LEGIONNAIRE, GIANT SKELETON and ERICH
